biological_interpretation: DDX3X loss is detectable as cell-specific neuronal abundance programs rather than a single translation/Wnt signature; the thalamic response emphasizes NMDA and junctional markers, while the midbrain response exposes a distinct Bicd2/Inha/Ppp2r5b compensation-like state.
caveats: Only two Ddx3x classes had any FDR-significant genes.
Wnt and translational biology are literature-supported for DDX3X, but the quoted neuronal rows do not directly measure translation, beta-catenin signaling, or RNA granules.
exact_observed_result: Ddx3x had two corrected downstream states: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed FDR-supported Ddx3x reduction with Grin2b, Synpo2, Plekhg1 and Ccdc136 down, whereas 155 MB Glut showed Thy1 down with Inha, Ppp2r5b and Bicd2 up and only nominal Ddx3x target depletion.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior work supports the broad molecular function of the perturbed target or complex, while the atlas result refines the affected brain cell type and RNA-output module.

resolved_evidence.description: The strongest FDR-resolved Ddx3x signature occurred in the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class and included the target transcript.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 138 Ddx3x cells versus 23679 controls; 8 genes at FDR<0.05: Ddx3x logFC -0.679 FDR=0.00289; Ypel3 +0.330 FDR=0.0157; Grin2b -0.243 FDR=0.0157; Plekhg1 -0.290 FDR=0.0164; Synpo2 -0.419 FDR=0.0164; Tmsb10 +0.487 FDR=0.0255; Tcea2 -0.495 FDR=0.0255; Ccdc136 -0.201 FDR=0.0408.

resolved_evidence.description: Measured 151 TH Prkcd statistics for selected Ddx3x-responsive and pathway-check genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ddx3x perturbation changed Grin2b logFC -0.243 FDR=0.0157; Synpo2 -0.419 FDR=0.0164; Plekhg1 -0.290 FDR=0.0164; Ccdc136 -0.201 FDR=0.0408; Vangl1 -0.439 p=4.03e-05, FDR=0.0726; Tnik -0.363 p=8.65e-05, FDR=0.136; Nrxn1 -0.212 p=7.78e-04, FDR=0.490; Dscam -0.291 p=8.22e-04, FDR=0.490. Axin2, Lef1, and Tcf7l2 were not nominally significant in the same signature, each p>0.05.

resolved_evidence.description: Across-class on-target expression change for the Ddx3x perturbation.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Ddx3x transcript rows were present in 22 cell classes; 19/22 logFC values were negative. One class passed FDR<0.05: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut logFC -0.679, score -5.232, p=1.67e-07, FDR=0.00289. Nine classes had nominal p<0.05 for Ddx3x.

resolved_evidence.description: The midbrain glutamatergic class showed the strongest downstream gene, Thy1, but weaker target-transcript FDR support than 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 136 Ddx3x cells versus 20353 controls; 4 non-target genes at FDR<0.05: Thy1 logFC -0.415 FDR=5.28e-05; Inha +0.384 FDR=0.00864; Ppp2r5b +0.474 FDR=0.0145; Bicd2 +0.468 FDR=0.0272. Ddx3x itself was nominally reduced but did not pass FDR: logFC -0.493, p=4.47e-04, FDR=0.223; Ddx5 was nominally induced: logFC +0.244, p=2.65e-05, FDR=0.0772.

resolved_evidence.description: Most Ddx3x perturbation profiles lacked conventional FDR-resolved downstream transcriptional changes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Only 2/22 Ddx3x-tested classes had any gene at FDR<0.05. Counts at nominal p<0.001 were: 155 MB Glut 45, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut 32, 191 MB P MY GABA 23, 217 P MY Pineal Glut 15, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut 11, and every other class <=9.

resolved_evidence.description: Several nominal Ddx3x-responsive genes recurred across posterior and GABA/glutamate classes despite most rows not passing per-cell-type FDR.
resolved_evidence.statistics: At nominal p<0.005, Bicd2 was up in 5 classes: 155 MB Glut logFC +0.468 p=6.24e-06, 217 P MY Pineal Glut +0.732 p=8.59e-05, 191 MB P MY GABA +0.578 p=1.28e-04, 054 CNU-MGE GABA +0.588 p=1.33e-04, and 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut +0.587 p=0.00141. Ddx5 was up in 155 MB Glut, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA with p<=3.60e-04; Tcea2 was down in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA with p<=1.56e-04; Wsb1 was up in the same three classes with p<=3.05e-04.

title: Ddx3x loss separates thalamic NMDA/junctional repression from a midbrain Thy1-down program
